sources.label: crawl of our 12 sites
sources.rotation_why: ORDER #3801 (Mimi 11.24.2026): every page of every sitemap on a stated cycle. Measured 11.25.2026: 377 sitemap pages on 11 sites (dreameventsandcatering.com 162; nashvilleweddingvenue.com has no sitemap). The old first-15 cap read about 165 and never reached the rest.

does: Crawls all 12 sites every Monday: every home page each week, and the rest of each sitemap in turns, so every page is read at least once every 4 weeks
Finds down pages, 404s, off-site redirects, missing titles and descriptions, extra H1s, duplicate titles across sites
Flags em dashes and AI-tell words in live page copy

traits.instead: Writes a ranked fix list, saying whether it is a WordPress or Squarespace fix
